title: Remove Duplicates
problem: The first line is a positive integer N. The second line holds N integers separated by spaces. Print the numbers with repeats removed, keeping only the first time each number appears, in the original order, separated by spaces. For example, 3 1 3 2 1 becomes 3 1 2.
starter_code:
# The first line is N, the second line holds N integers.
# Print each number once, the first time it appears, in the original order.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Keep track of the numbers you have already kept, and skip one you have seen before.
hints.2: Loop over the numbers, keep a set of the ones already seen, and only add a number to the result the first time you meet it. Turning the whole list into a set loses the original order, so that alone is not enough.
hints.3:
input()
seen, out = set(), []
for x in input().split():
    if x not in seen:
        seen.add(x)
        out.append(x)
print(' '.join(out))

failure_explanation: Keep the numbers in the order they first appear: a set or sorted() removes the repeats but also changes the order. Keep each number only the first time you meet it, and print the result separated by spaces.
